SPANISH 101A | Introduction to Iberian Literature and Culture
SPANISH 101B | Introductory Studies to Latin American Literature and Culture
SPANISH 113B | Introduction to Spanish Linguistics
SPANISH 119 | Textual Analysis and Interpretation
SPANISH 190 | Colloquium
B. Complete seven additional Spanish courses by the Department of Spanish and Portuguese 1,2,3,4
Requirements for the B.A. in Spanish
Departmental Requirements for the Major
12 courses (48 units) are required for the major.
A maximum of one from SPANISH 3 and SPANISH 3H may apply.
A maximum of two from the following may apply: SPANISH 50 , SPANISH 61 , SPANISH 62 , and SPANISH 60E .
No other lower-division courses are permitted.
A maximum of one upper-division course taught in English may apply. This course may be taken outside the Department of Spanish and Portuguese as long as the course is relevant to topics of U.S. Latino communities, Latin America, or Spain and it is approved by the Undergraduate Director of the Department of Spanish and Portuguese.
Residence Requirement for the Major: At least five upper-division courses required for the major must be completed successfully at UCI. By petition, two of the five may be taken through the UC Education Abroad Program, providing course content is approved by the Humanities Office of Undergraduate Study and the Undergraduate Director of the Department of Spanish and Portuguese.
